summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of LabStock Phase 1 foundation. All backend APIs (13/13) and frontend features tested successfully. Data seeding working correctly with 117 reagen, 247 test mappings, daily usage data, PRF, and penerimaan records. Business logic calculations verified. UI navigation, filters, search, and CRUD operations all functional.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/health returns status ok and seeded true
Backend: GET /api/meta/periods returns Agustus 2026 and Juli 2026
Backend: GET /api/meta/excel-summary returns complete Excel analysis document
Backend: GET /api/monitoring?year=2026&month=7 returns correct data with 117 reagen, counts (7 kritis, 6 waspada, 41 aman, 63 perlu cek)
Backend: GET /api/monitoring?year=2026&month=8 returns correct data with 117 reagen, counts (12 kritis, 7 waspada, 41 aman, 57 perlu cek)
Backend: Business logic calculations verified - total_pemakaian = sum(daily) + QC, sisa_stock = (saldo_awal - total_pemakaian) + stok_masuk
Backend: Status logic verified - KRITIS (sisa<=buffer), WASPADA (buffer<sisa<=buffer+10), AMAN (sisa>buffer+10), PERLU CEK (saldo_awal null)
Backend: GET /api/reagen returns 117 reagen with correct structure
Backend: GET /api/reagen?query=Ca filters correctly (10 results)
Backend: PUT /api/reagen/{id} updates buffer_stock and persists successfully
Backend: GET /api/mapping-tests returns 247 total (116 OK, 131 TIDAK ADA)
Backend: GET /api/mapping-tests?status=OK filters correctly
Backend: GET /api/lis/raw?period=2026-07 returns 999 total items with pagination
Backend: GET /api/prf?period=2026-07 returns 31 PRF items
Backend: GET /api/penerimaan?period=2026-07 returns 30 items with computed total_qty=2602
Frontend: Dashboard loads with correct page title and KPI cards
Frontend: All 5 KPI cards display correctly (Total Reagen: 117, Kritis: 12, Waspada: 7, Aman: 41, Perlu Cek: 57)
Frontend: Critical reagen table displays with 'Lihat semua' link
Frontend: All 6 quick access links (Akses Cepat) render correctly
Frontend: Sidebar navigation contains all 7 menu items
Frontend: Period selector (month/year) renders in topbar
Frontend: Navigation to Pemantauan Stok page successful
Frontend: Pemantauan Stok table renders with day columns 1-31
Frontend: All 5 status filter chips work (Semua, Kritis, Waspada, Aman, Perlu Cek)
Frontend: Status filter functionality works - clicking Kritis filters rows
Frontend: Search filter works - typing 'Ca' filters reagen by name
Frontend: Navigation to Master Reagen page successful
Frontend: Master Reagen table displays 117 items
Frontend: Master Reagen search filters correctly
Frontend: Edit dialog opens with all form fields (buffer_stock, qty_per_kit, avg_2022, avg_2023, satuan, item_code)
Frontend: Edit dialog closes on 'Batal' button
Frontend: Navigation to Data LIS page successful
Frontend: Data LIS tabs (Pemetaan Test, Data LIS Mentah) render correctly
Frontend: Pemetaan Test tab shows mapping table with OK/TIDAK ADA status
Frontend: Data LIS Mentah tab shows raw LIS data table
Frontend: Navigation to PRF page successful - table displays 31 items for 2026-08
Frontend: Navigation to Penerimaan page successful - table displays 21 items with total qty 1,375 for 2026-08
Frontend: Navigation to Analisis Struktur Excel page successful
Frontend: Analisis Excel page renders all sections (sheets, columns, formulas, status colors, entities)
Frontend: Period selector changes data - switching from Agustus to Juli updates KPIs correctly
Frontend: All screenshots captured successfully (8 screenshots)

additional_notes.expected_behavior: Many reagen show status 'PERLU CEK' (unknown) - 63 in Juli 2026 and 57 in Agustus 2026. This is EXPECTED and correct behavior because saldo_awal was #REF! (broken reference) in the original Excel file. This is NOT a bug - the system is faithfully representing the source data state.
additional_notes.data_seeding: Auto-seeding on backend startup successful: 117 reagen, 200 stock_period records, daily usage data (pemakaian_harian), 247 test mappings, 999 LIS raw records, 31 PRF items, 30 penerimaan items
additional_notes.business_logic: All calculations verified correct: total_pemakaian = sum(hari[1..31]) + qc, sisa_stock = (saldo_awal - total_pemakaian) + stok_masuk, status colors based on sisa vs buffer thresholds
additional_notes.ui_quality: Clean, professional UI in Bahasa Indonesia. Responsive design with mobile sidebar. Good use of shadcn/ui components. Status badges with appropriate colors (red/yellow/green/gray). Dense monitoring table with sticky column for reagen names.
additional_notes.phase_1_scope: Foundation complete: landing/dashboard, monitoring table, master reagen CRUD, Data LIS (read-only), PRF list, Penerimaan list, Excel analysis page. NO auth (as specified). NO LIS import integration or auto usage simulation (deferred to later phases).
